title: Accessibility
description: Accessibility settings for STEEVEFAX: a plain text view, keyboard shortcuts and an old-TV screen effect, each with an on/off switch, and how visits are counted.
label: A11Y

subpages.text: Use the switches below the screen.

subpages: Shows every page as plain text, without the TV screen. The site remembers your choice.
Type a page number to go there. R, G, Y and B are the coloured buttons. H stops a page changing. Turn these off if you use voice control.
Adds the lines and glow of an old TV. It's off at first if your device asks for less motion or more contrast.
Zoom in any time to make text bigger.
Visits are counted with Umami, which uses no cookies and collects nothing that identifies you.
It records which pages are read, where visitors came from, their country and type of device, and which links and switches are used.
The switches save your choices in this browser only. They are never sent anywhere.
